evidence.theOneAddedSentence: Grounded, disclosed, and minimal, but still not hers. CL-008 is mandatory and requires the limit stated in the same breath as the claim; the submission stated a limit only once, in the closing section, which is what the Brand Guardian flagged under CL-008 and what Audience flagged HIGH. The sentence makes no checkable factual claim, cites nothing and introduces no number, so it is not a hallucination and I have not listed it. evidence.meaningPreserved: Yes, with one narrowing I examined closely and decided is not drift. The section 1 bullet went from "can replace an external consulting team's discovery phase in an afternoon" to "can run much of a consulting team's discovery phase themselves": the scope shrinks from replace to run much of, the speed claim is deleted, and "external" is dropped. The final therefore says strictly less than the author wrote, in the direction of accuracy, on the one claim the Fact Checker rated UNVERIFIED with the instruction not to publish it as established fact; Compliance (MEDIUM) and Audience (HIGH, CL-010) flagged the same sentence. meaningDriftFound is for a sentence that now says something the author did not say. A mandated reduction in the strength of a claim is the policy's own remedy, and listing it as drift would block publication over the correction the policy requires. It is logged as an advisory instead, because the published sibling still carries the claim at full strength. The other softenings are of the same kind and smaller: "fundamentally disrupt" to "change" (VC-001, mandatory, object kept), "impossible" to "much harder" (three agents), "40-page deck" to "a deck of about 40 pages" (CL-010, her digit kept, hedge added), "very expensive" to "expensive" in the subtitle (VC-002, and identical to the published sibling's subtitle). Her thesis, her three-part structure, her counter-risk section, her idioms and her closing two sentences are intact and verbatim.
evidence.noNewClaimWithoutEvidence: CONFIRMED. The final contains no URL, no citation, no named source, no study, no statistic and no person's name. The only figure in the body is the author's own "40", now carrying "about" per CL-010. The Fact Checker's research — the HBS/BCG field experiment, 758 consultants, about 25% faster, and https://d3.harvard.edu/future-proof-with-ai/?p=1136 — was deliberately kept out of the article and recorded in integration.json for the author to use if she wants the claim back. evidence.whyRepairAndNotAccept: The prose is finished. Every article-level issue I raised in round 1 is closed, G1 and G6 both pass, there are no hallucinations and no drift, and the one non-author sentence is rule-mandated, disclosed and traceable to the author's own long version. I would accept the text. I am not accepting the package: two of my four round-1 repair instructions were not carried out at all, the remaining defects are mechanical and touch none of the author's words, and one of them is a live hazard — publishing_metadata.json still names the published long form as the destination slug.
